parent_objective: audit M2388 fail-closed reset validation result and choose schema repair, pivot, or stop route
blocked_by: M2388 static validation passes but generated candidate configs lack env_config
reset compatibility remains untested because validator correctly stopped before environment loading
supersedes: direct reset rerun without auditing schema incompleteness
direct repair execution, training, or ranking from M2388 failed reset validation

public_gates: M2389 must audit M2388 without rerunning validation
M2389 must classify schema incompleteness versus sampler incompatibility
M2389 must choose bounded schema repair, pivot, synthesis, or stop route
M2389 must not run reset rollout repair training ranking or paper/self-ID/current-sim verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle features
do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits fail-closed reset validation result and decides whether schema repair is justified
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no reset rerun, rollout, repair execution, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if audit treats schema incompleteness as reset success
stop if audit routes directly to rollout training ranking or paper conclusions
stop if audit ignores the local-search risk of another artifact schema repair
fallback_plan: route to effective-config schema repair design if schema repair is bounded and necessary
pivot to complexity-pruning synthesis if schema repair would add only local artifact work
stop for user review if reset validation is no longer the highest-leverage route
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2388 fail-closed result requires audit before any schema repair or rerun

training_stage.stage_objective: candidate config reset validation result audit
allowed_updates: M2389 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: reset compatibility remains blocked unless reset attempts occurred
a bounded schema repair, pivot, synthesis, or stop route is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2389 audits reset readiness and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2389; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Schema incompleteness must be recorded as a reset-readiness blocker, not interpreted as driver capability evidence.
allowed_claims: candidate config reset validation result audit
no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: classifies generated candidate configs as statically clean but not reset-ready
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: blocks current-sim validation until effective config schema is repaired or branch pivots
must_synthesize_if: M2389 cannot choose a bounded schema repair or pivot route
M2389 proposes another artifact-only repair without executable validation path
the repair-plan materialization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: Auditing M2388 will show the failure is schema incompleteness rather than unsafe execution, and will select a bounded next route without weakening the claim boundary.
success_criteria: M2388 static pass and schema incompleteness counts are recorded
no reset rerun rollout repair execution training ranking or paper/self-ID/current-sim verdict claim occurs
a bounded follow-up route is selected or the branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2389 reruns reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2389 treats schema incompleteness as reset success
M2389 executes repair levers or trains
M2389 ranks support policies or controller families
M2389 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU current-sim verdict or level3 self-ID claims
M2389 claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success
decision_rule: M2389 passes if it audits the fail-closed reset validation result, preserves the claim boundary, and selects a bounded schema repair, pivot, synthesis, or stop route.
